description: Scaffold: pubspec with pinned packages, folder layout, theme, router, app shell, AndroidManifest. Transforms the project from a bare single-file app into the full layered structure ready for feature code. All screens are placeholder stubs; the app must run and analyze clean after this FEAT.
steps: Update pubspec.yaml. Under 'dependencies' add exactly: flutter_riverpod: 3.4.3, go_router: 18.0.2, camera: 0.12.1, image_picker: 1.2.4, shared_preferences: 2.5.6, path_provider: 2.1.6. Under 'dev_dependencies' add: mocktail: 1.0.5. Keep flutter SDK dependency, flutter_test SDK dev dependency, uses-material-design: true, and all existing asset declarations (assets/data/ingredients.json, assets/data/recipes.json, assets/data/prices.json, assets/config/app_config.json, assets/models/). Do NOT add http, dio, firebase_*, or any analytics package.

Append to docs/DECISIONS.md the package decisions block: '## Packages added FEAT-001
- flutter_riverpod: 3.4.3 (pub.dev, supports Android, state management)
- go_router: 18.0.2 (pub.dev, supports Android, declarative routing)
- camera: 0.12.1 (pub.dev, supports Android, camera stream)
- image_picker: 1.2.4 (pub.dev, supports Android, photo fallback)
- shared_preferences: 2.5.6 (pub.dev, supports Android, preferences persistence)
- path_provider: 2.1.6 (pub.dev, supports Android, file paths for LLM model)
- mocktail: 1.0.5 (pub.dev, dev-only, mocking in tests)'

Create or update android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Must include <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.CAMERA'/> inside the <manifest> tag. Must NOT include <uses-permission android:name='android.permission.INTERNET'/>. Keep the existing application block (activity, intent-filter, metadata) intact. If the file does not exist, create a minimal valid AndroidManifest.xml for Flutter with the applicationId com.example.snapfood, CAMERA permission, and the standard FlutterActivity setup.

Create lib/app/theme.dart: export a single AppTheme class with a static ThemeData get light method. Theme must use Material 3 (useMaterial3: true), ColorScheme.fromSeed with seedColor Color(0xFF1C684E), scaffoldBackgroundColor Color(0xFFF7F5EF), cardTheme with white card color, elevation 0, RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22), side: BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE8E6DE))). Preserve every visual detail from the existing main.dart SnapFoodApp ThemeData block.

Create lib/features/shared/on_device_badge.dart: stateless widget OnDeviceBadge. Accepts a ModelStatus enum (defined in lib/ml/model_store.dart in FEAT-003, use a local forward-compatible stub: enum ModelStatus { missing, present, loading, ready, failed, mock } for now). Renders a compact Row with a phone_android icon, status text, and a colored tag chip. When status is mock, show 'ON DEVICE · MOCK' in amber. When missing, show 'Setup Required'. When ready, show 'Ready' in green. Always visible. This widget replaces _MiniStatus and _ModelStatus from main.dart.

Create lib/app/router.dart: define a GoRouter instance (exported as appRouter) with five GoRoute entries: path '/' → HomeScreen (placeholder), path '/scan' → ScanScreen (placeholder), path '/review' → ReviewScreen (placeholder), path '/results' → ResultsScreen (placeholder), path '/recipe/:id' → DetailScreen (placeholder, receives id from pathParameters). Import placeholder screen stubs from each feature folder. Use GoRouter's extra parameter for passing data between screens (not Navigator.push).
Create lib/app/app_shell.dart: MaterialApp.router using appRouter and AppTheme.light. Wraps with ProviderScope at the top-level in main.dart.

Replace lib/main.dart with a thin entry point: void main() => runApp(const ProviderScope(child: AppShell())); Import only ProviderScope from flutter_riverpod and AppShell from lib/app/app_shell.dart. Remove all the old scaffold code.

Create placeholder stub screen files — each is a minimal Scaffold with an AppBar showing the screen name and a centered Text('TODO'). This makes the router importable and the app compilable. Files to create: lib/features/home/home_screen.dart (class HomeScreen), lib/features/scan/scan_screen.dart (class ScanScreen), lib/features/review/review_screen.dart (class ReviewScreen), lib/features/results/results_screen.dart (class ResultsScreen), lib/features/detail/detail_screen.dart (class DetailScreen, accepts String id from GoRouterState.pathParameters).

Create lib/core/logger.dart: a simple wrapper around dart:developer log(). Expose four static methods: Logger.d(msg), Logger.i(msg), Logger.w(msg), Logger.e(msg, {error, stackTrace}). In release builds (kReleaseMode) the debug/info/warn methods are no-ops.
Run 'flutter pub get' to resolve dependencies, then run 'flutter analyze' and 'flutter test'. Expect analyze to report no errors. There are no tests yet so flutter test passes trivially.
acceptance_criteria: pubspec.yaml contains exactly the six runtime packages at their pinned versions with no http, dio, firebase_*, or analytics packages
docs/DECISIONS.md contains the package decisions block with all seven packages and versions
android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml contains CAMERA permission and does NOT contain INTERNET permission
lib/app/theme.dart, lib/app/router.dart, lib/app/app_shell.dart exist and compile
lib/main.dart is a thin entry point (ProviderScope + AppShell only)
All five placeholder screen files exist and compile
lib/features/shared/on_device_badge.dart and lib/core/logger.dart exist and compile
